{{Otheruses|Phoenix}}
The '''Phoenix''' were a political dynasty that existed during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. In [[104 ABY]], [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Gabrel Treon]] mentioned the Phoenix in "[[Tinker, Tailor, Soldier, Praji: A Cartel of Genes]]," a history of the [[House Praji/Legends|Praji family]] that was published in the [[Byblos Journal of Historical Science]].
